Hi Alice / Ben —

Thanks — confirmed us-east and noted PO timeline. Quick ops notes and proposals based on Alice's numbers: 

1) Warmup / burst behavior: with Dedicated we support warmup policies that keep a small warm pool (configurable) and burst to reserved capacity + ephemeral nodes. Typical cold-to-warm spin-up for extra nodes is ~45–90s depending on model context length; with a small warm pool (2–4 GPUs) you can reduce tail risk to ~15–30s.

2) Autoscale proposal (starting point):
- Steady target: maintain 95% CPU/GPU utilization target at 40 rps baseline
- Burst trigger: queue/backlog > 200 requests OR P95 latency > 300ms for 60s => scale +2 nodes
- Max burst: +6 nodes beyond baseline for the first 30 days, subject to regional capacity availability

3) Fallback routing: agree on automated fallback to quantized variant. We'll set a circuit-breaker: if error-rate > 2% for 3m OR P50 > 350ms => reroute to quantized variant for up to 10 minutes, then re-evaluate. We'll include transparent metrics in Console so you can track quality regressions.

4) Networking: we support VPC peering/private connectivity; netops will need the IP ranges and peering window. I'll add a short checklist in the Drive folder.

Attaching a sample metrics export to show how thresholds behaved in a recent pilot: [attachment: autoscale_metrics_sample.csv (CSV, 45KB)]

Ben — can you add these thresholds into the SOW and push an updated version to DocuSign once procurement confirms the PO contact?

—Monica
